ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels, estimated at approximately 15:85, with dark pigmentation dominating the central and lower regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is concentrated on the distal tips and upper outer margins of both lobes. Contiguous white clusters are mapped along the lower-left proximal margin. The remainder of the fluke presents a uniform low-intensity black distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45-50 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable large semi-circular indentations (likely notches) are present on the inner upper margin of the left lobe and mid-upper margin of the right lobe. Far right tip exhibits high-amplitude jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing margins of both lobes, transitioning to sharp convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete cluster of approximately 3-5 high-contrast white circular nodes at the far-left distal tip. A series of smaller, isolated circular white clusters are mapped along the lower-left margin. A single distinct white circular mark is visible on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, parallel curvilinear high-contrast white marks (rake marks) located on the upper-central region of the left lobe. Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are scattered across the dark central surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss on the trailing edges of both lobes, particularly the deep U-shaped notch on the inner left lobe. A single, bright white circular scar is positioned on the lower-center peduncle base.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, high-intensity white focal point is located on the vertical axis of the fluke peduncle, isolated from other pigmentation patterns.
